meta.headline: London + Dublin notes
meta.stayBudget: Stay budget under $800 total for those two nights. Nothing booked.

places.name: Blind Spot
places.address: Inside St Martins Lane hotel, 45 St Martin's Lane
places.description: Hidden speakeasy (golden-hand door behind the tea counter). Globally inspired cocktails. Open Wed from 5pm. Cocktail hour second sip free 5–7pm. Easy pick for drinks before Dishoom.
places.note: Confirmed on OpenTable: Wed 16 Sep 2026 at 19:30 for 2 (Billy & Isabel), before Dishoom. Cancel with 24h notice or £20/person may apply.

places.name: Eve Bar
places.description: Adam Handling basement cocktail bar; serious mixology / date-night room.

places.name: Side Hustle
places.description: Agave-led cocktails, nicer room, slightly longer walk from Dishoom.

places.name: Dishoom Covent Garden
places.description: Bombay café / Indian. Dinner locked Wed 16 Sep ~9pm for Billy and Isabel.
places.note: After 6pm online reservations are usually for groups of 6+; they already have the booking.

places.name: The Fielding Hotel
places.description: Small townhouse opposite the Royal Opera House. Skip room 43 (no window). Google 4.1/5 (387 reviews); Booking about 8.2.
places.note: Price snapshot checked ~8 Sep 2026: Google Hotels about $622 total with taxes for Wed 16 Sep–Fri 18 Sep 2026. Recheck before booking. Not booked.

places.name: The Z Hotel Tottenham Court Road
places.description: Compact modern Z Queen in Soho. Official flexible rate (£679) does not fit under $800.
places.note: Price snapshot for Wed 16 Sep–Fri 18 Sep 2026: official prepaid non-refundable £548 taxes included (about $742). Booking.com also showed a Queen about $572 before VAT (about $686 with VAT). Recheck before booking. Not booked.

places.name: Ridgemount Hotel
places.description: Triple with a window, private bath, and breakfast. Score 8.6. About 15–18 min walk to Soho.
places.note: Price snapshot for Wed 16 Sep–Fri 18 Sep 2026: about $628 shown / about $754 with 20% VAT. Recheck before booking. Not booked.

places.name: The Grand at Trafalgar Square
places.description: About 12–15 min to Soho. Same address block as Club Quarters.
places.note: Price snapshot for Wed 16 Sep–Fri 18 Sep 2026: Google Hotels about $781 total with taxes. Recheck before booking. Not booked.
